title.purpose: Screen titles only; the largest voice the UI scale carries.

body.purpose: Reading-level UI text; leaves display scale free for the Arabic ayah.

label.purpose: Tab labels and small tags; the only letterspaced voice.

motion.name: press-spring
motion.purpose: Selection and press feedback; Compose springs, never ripples.

motion.name: row-highlight
motion.purpose: Pressed list-row highlight; fades out slower than in.

motion.name: state-snap
motion.purpose: Color swaps that must read instant: tab selection, mark-state across an ayah swipe.

motion.name: mark-read-tween
motion.purpose: Direct-tap mark/unmark cross-fades; snap() replaces it on verse change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one shared primary CTA: full-width sage capsule, 48dp tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #71835F; color: #FBFAF6; border: none; border-radius: 999px; height: 48px; width: 100%; font: 600 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .35; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71835F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Action
components.description: Small capsule action (Grant, Mark Read): sage-soft fill, sage text.
components.css: .ds-pill-action { background: #E3E8DA; color: #71835F; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 22px; font: 600 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-action:active { transform: scale(.86); } .ds-pill-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71835F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Radio-style selector chip; one live per group, selected fills accent.
components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: #8A8275; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 15px; font: 500 12.5px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #71835F; color: #FBFAF6; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71835F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Slim custom toggle: 44×26 track, 20dp paper knob; on = accent.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 26px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #71835F; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F6F3EC; transition: transform .2s; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] { background: #E4DFD2; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"]::after { transform: translateX(0); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"]::after { transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71835F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Detached capsule nav; selected tab gets a sage-soft pill, instant color swap.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-evenly; background: #FCFBF7; border: 1px solid rgba(228,223,210,.6); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 0; margin: 0 20px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: none; color: #8A8275; font: 600 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 27px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-tab-selected { color: #71835F; } .ds-tab-selected .ds-tab-pill { background: #E3E8DA; }

components.name: Reading Card
components.description: The signature surface: hairline-bordered paper with centered ayah content.

components.css: .ds-reading-card { background: rgba(228,223,210,.12); border: 1px solid #E4DFD2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 270px; justify-content: center; } .ds-reading-surah { font: 600 13.5px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2A2823; } .ds-reading-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #8A8275; font: 600 12px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .25px; } .ds-rule { width: 18px; height: 1px; background: #E4DFD2; } .ds-reading-arabic { font-family: "Amiri", "Scheherazade New", serif; font-size: 28px; color: #2A2823; } .ds-reading-translit { font: 400 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #8A8275; } .ds-reading-translation { font: 400 13.5px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2A2823; border-top: 1px solid #E4DFD2; padding-top: 10px; width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
Waqfah's interface is a page, not an app chrome: warm paper, one voice of ink, hairline rules where a heavier system would draw boxes or cast shadows. The reading pause it inserts into someone's day is visually the same object as the Home tab that teaches it — a quiet page of ink on warm paper that appears, is read or skipped, and falls away. Nothing glows, nothing blurs, nothing begs. The system is calm, warm, and literary: a printed page that happens to glow.

Depth is conveyed by ink density, never by elevation: a 1dp hairline in line, or a faint tint of the same color, separates content from paper. Motion is tactile but restrained — springs on selection, small press-shrinks, instant color swaps where animation would read as lag. Confirmed anti-references: neon accent glow, glass blur, gamified streaks, Material's default ripple and floating-label fields.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper backgrounds with a full ink-to-muted-to-soft text ladder
Full-capsule (pill) geometry for every interactive element
Flat surfaces: 1dp hairline borders and line-tinted fills, zero shadows
No ripples; press feedback is scale-shrink and a slow-fading highlight
One accent voice per theme, swappable from five hand-tuned accents
Three bundled Arabic typefaces as first-class content, not decoration

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most one or two elements per screen. If a second element needs emphasis, promote it with ink weight, not a second color.

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy is ink → inkMuted → inkSoft, never opacity fades of ink and never new grays. Every palette ships all three.

rules.name: The Hand-Tuned Rule
rules.body: Never derive a companion color at runtime (lerps, luminance thresholds). Every accent/palette/mode combination is a hand-written value, because derivation visibly drifts in dark themes.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: UI text uses the system font at modest sizes; custom typefaces are reserved for Quranic content. Importing a display font for chrome would break the page metaphor.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: This system is flat by conviction: not one shadow exists. Depth is a 1dp hairline border, a 12%-alpha line tint, or — dark themes only — a subtle lightening of floating surfaces. Never shadows, gradient depth, or blur.

dos: Do use the 9-role custom palette (WaqfahTheme.colors) — accent, accentInk, accentSoft, background, ink, inkMuted, inkSoft, line, danger.
Do put every interactive element in a capsule; circle for icon-only.
Do give press feedback as scale (springs, MediumBouncy for selection) or the row highlight (60ms in, 220ms out).
Do hand-write every new color's light and dark values per palette.
Do give custom controls real semantics (Role.Switch, Role.RadioButton, Role.Tab) and merge duplicated TalkBack announcements away.
donts: Don't add shadows, elevation, blur, or gradient depth — The Hairline Rule has no exceptions.
Don't use Material's default ripple, Switch, floating-label TextField, or filled arrow icons (the hand-drawn two-segment chevron exists because Material's glyphs read heavier).
Don't invent grays or fade ink with alpha — climb the ink ladder.
Don't let a second color compete with the accent on one screen.
Don't animate a color swap that must feel instant (tab selection, ayah-swipe state) — snap it.
Don't fix Arabic text sizes in dp or hardcode LTR around RTL content.
